assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production GAME BACKGROUND bitmap, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080, for a browser educational science game. No interface, no text.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference. Recreate its beautiful warm illustrated 2.5D storybook science laboratory: handcrafted polished walnut wood, dark forest teal, antique brass, honey sunlight from left, cream paper, intriguing academic mystery suitable for middle-school students.
We will overlay separately rendered interactive chalkboard, professor, four beakers, open notebook, and microscope in HTML. Therefore DO NOT paint any of those interactive objects into this background.
Composition is critical: straight-on fixed game camera. A largely empty dark muted TEAL WALL across the upper central 55% of image, clear space from x=24% to x=73%, y=6% to y=58%, to place a large chalkboard. Do NOT include a chalkboard or its frame there, just wall and subtle ambient texture. Left 20% has sunlit old window, modest leafy plant and blurred shelf glassware. Right outer edge has books and soft-focus shelves. The large foreground walnut bench starts at y=68%, spans full width, has generous EMPTY countertop across x=7% to x=96% for four beakers, notebook and microscope to be overlaid. Clearly visible horizontal counter surface, front edge at 91% height. Back-right space x=76% to94%, y=24% to75% clear for a professor character, with only a dim wooden chair behind. A sliced raw potato and folded linen can be partially visible in extreme bottom-left corner, not central workspace. Subtle scattered papers at extreme edges only.
Materials: restrained tactile hand-painted 3D game art, sophisticated cinematic lighting but clear shapes, clean enough for readable interactive objects. Vignette edges gently; no excessive clutter or sparkle. Color palette is warm cream and honey wooden highlights against forest teal wall.
Constraints: NO people, NO professor, NO beakers on counter, NO microscope, NO open notebook, NO chalkboard, NO writing, NO UI, NO numbers, NO watermark, no logos, no baked-in interactive labels, no exaggerated fisheye perspective. Deliver one clean scene asset.

assets.purpose: Four equal CSS sprite frames with transparent background
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent-background GAME CHARACTER SPRITE STRIP, four poses, wide 3:1 canvas. This bitmap will be shown using CSS background-position in four exactly equal horizontal slots.
Input image 1 is a character identity and style reference: the silver-haired long-nosed professor at the right. Recreate exactly that appealing mature academic NPC with swept silver hair, distinctive long pointed nose, expressive thick eyebrows, small round brass spectacles, dark forest-teal jacket, rust waistcoat, ivory shirt with rolled cuffs, mustard bow tie. Softly dimensional hand-painted storybook 2.5D game art, not a photo of a real person.
Composition MUST have FOUR separate WAIST-UP portraits side-by-side, at precisely 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% of total width, identical character size and baseline. Transparent background everywhere between and around characters, no colored backgrounds or checkerboard baked into artwork, no frames. Each entire head, hair, nose, shoulders and arms fits completely within its own quarter-width slot with 8% safe side margins. Cut off each figure cleanly at waist along shared bottom baseline. Characters face slightly left, towards a chalkboard outside the image. No props.
Left to right states:
1 PROUD: chin high, elongated nose tilted up, amused confident eyebrow, arms crossed.
2 SKEPTICAL: eyebrow raised, index finger on chin, inquisitive look.
3 SURPRISED: brows lifted, modest surprise, one hand raised palm open, nose slightly lower.
4 ACKNOWLEDGING: warm crooked smile, shoulders relaxed, chin and nose lowered, small approving nod and hands resting together.
No chair, no table, no other people, no scenery, no extra heads, no floating accessories, no words, no labels, no watermark. Exactly FOUR same-identity portraits in four equally sized slots. Preserve genuine transparency.

assets.initialCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised microscope membrane-experiment concept mockup for a middle-school science game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its room, brass-rimmed lens, interface layout, typography, warm cream control panel and bottom collection tray.
Make these exact corrections:
1. Within the lens REMOVE ALL phospholipid molecules, heads, tails, bead rows and the existing one-sided membrane illustration. Replace the membrane with ONE SINGLE THIN SMOOTH translucent curved line, about 3-5 pixels apparent width, with a restrained pale teal highlight. No lipid structural diagram, no double layer, no pores rendered as proteins. Keep this very simple for middle-school students.
2. The membrane separates LEFT "세포 밖" from RIGHT "세포 안". Keep the LEFT outside a deep dark navy teal. Make the RIGHT INSIDE visibly BRIGHTER, a softly luminous pale aqua-teal region with sufficient contrast for blue water and amber sugar tokens. The thin boundary must clearly divide the two light levels; brighter region is unambiguously the inside.
3. Continue to show blue water tokens passing through the thin boundary from outside to inside, and an amber hexagon gently rebounding on the OUTSIDE. Keep the labels "물 · 통과" and "설탕 · 거의 통과하지 못함". No sugar crosses. No organelles.
4. Update the two bottom evidence cards to match the CURRENT game data, replacing old M/% values: left card exact "5% · +3 g"; right card exact "10% · −5 g". Do not keep any "0.2 M", "0.4 M", "+3%" or "−5%" anywhere. Top active step remains 3 "반박" only.
Keep all remaining Korean UI text as is, including "개념 모형", "막 통과 실험", "분자를 세포막으로 끌어 보자.", "물", "설탕", "실험대로 돌아가기". No other changes. One landscape screenshot.
assets.finalCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. This is the membrane experiment design for middle-school students. Preserve the room, all interface panels, labels, top bar, brass lens, bottom evidence values "5% · +3 g" and "10% · −5 g".
Change the concept-model geometry inside the lens: the cell INSIDE must be enclosed completely by ONE CLOSED ROUND CIRCULAR THIN MEMBRANE, not divided from outside by a vertical line.
Remove the vertical boundary entirely. Draw a single thin smooth pale-aqua circular outline, clearly closed all the way around, centered at the center of the large lens, with its diameter about 58% of the lens diameter. The interior of this circle is BRIGHT soft light aqua. The entire surrounding area between the cell circle and the lens rim is DARK navy teal. This is a small round bright cell INSIDE a larger dark microscope field.
Place the label "세포 안" INSIDE the bright cell near its top. Place "세포 밖" OUTSIDE the bright cell, above and slightly left in the dark ring.
Blue water tokens are both outside and inside. A short clear trajectory goes from dark outside THROUGH the thin circular membrane into the bright circular cell, with "물 · 통과". One amber sugar hexagon gently rebounds at the OUTSIDE edge of that circle, with "설탕 · 거의 통과하지 못함". Some amber hexagons inside the cell are fine as background solute, but none visibly pass through the membrane.
No phospholipid beads, heads, tails, proteins, double membrane strokes, cell wall or organelles. Only ONE thin smooth CLOSED CIRCULAR line encloses the whole bright cell. Keep all other artwork and Korean labels unchanged.
